parameters.toolDescription: Verify that a block name exists in the West Bengal administrative hierarchy. Call after the user provides their block name. Send JSON with the block and district.
Check if a similar complaint already exists for this phone + category + block. Call before final registration after all fields are collected.
Submit the complaint and receive a ticket number (WB-YYYY-XXXXX). Call ONLY after the citizen confirms all details.
Persist current session state (last_intent, collected_data, language). Call after every turn where you collect or update information.
Submit a new blood request to the system. Call after the seeker confirms all request details (blood_group, units, hospital, urgency, contact_phone, district, block).
Record a donor's HAAN (yes) or NAHI (no) response to a pending blood request. Call when the donor sends a positive/negative response.
Handle the seeker's 15-minute confirmation callback from JS-16. Call when session.last_intent === 'seeker_confirming'.
Persist current session state (last_intent, collected_data, language). Call after every turn.
Register a new blood donor in the system. Call after all registration fields are collected and confirmed (naam, blood_group, gender, date_of_birth, weight_kg, district, block).
Update donor availability for PAUSE or RESUME commands. Pass command = 'PAUSE' or 'RESUME'.
Check if this phone number is already registered as a donor. Call before RegisterDonor.
Record a completed donation with details (donated_date, donation_type, hospital, units). Call after the DONATED command and details are collected.
Apply a temporary or permanent deferral. Call after the DEFER command and reason/duration are collected. Send reason and deferral_until.
Persist current session state (last_intent, collected_data, language). Call after every turn.

nodes.name: Fire Observability
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget side branch (Design §Observability). Fires routing_decision + agent_invocation logs to JS-01v2-Observability. continueOnFail=true so logging failures never break the reply path.

meta.description: JS-01v2 Multi-Agent Router. Rule-based CEO Router (Code Node, no LLM) dispatches each WhatsApp message via a single Switch Node to one of four specialist AI Agents (Complaint, Blood, Donor) + Status/Info Code path + Welcome Code, with a default Fallback branch (Reliability NFR). Each agent has a Google Gemini model, agent-level memory DISABLED, and a restricted tool set. Observability writes (routing_decisions + agent_invocations) are fire-and-forget after the reply. JS-08 Watchdog wired as the global error workflow.
meta.errorTrigger: JS-08-Watchdog (global error workflow, registered via settings.errorWorkflow)
